actions.name: Kwampirs RAT gains system access to victim machines and networks
actions.description: The Kwampirs RAT is a modular RAT worm that gains system access to victim machines and networks, with the primary purpose of gaining broad, yet targeted, access to victim companies to enable follow-on computer network exploitation (CNE) activities.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Kwampirs RAT performs daily command and control communications with hard-coded malicious IP addresses and domains
actions.description: During these campaigns, the Kwampirs RAT performed daily command and control communications with malicious IP addresses and domains that were hard-coded in the Kwampirs RAT malware.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Kwampirs actors gain access to global hospitals through vendor software supply chain and hardware products
actions.description: The FBI assesses Kwampirs actors gained access to a large number of global hospitals through vendor software supply chain and hardware products.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Kwampirs campaign establishes broad and persistent presence on targeted network
actions.description: This campaign employs a two-phased approach. The first phase establishes a broad and persistent presence on the targeted network, to include delivery and execution of secondary malware payload(s).
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Kwampirs campaign delivers additional Kwampirs components or malicious payloads to further exploit infected victim hosts
actions.description: The second phase includes the delivery of additional Kwampirs components or malicious payload(s) to further exploit the infected victim host(s).
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Kwampirs RAT deploys targeted secondary module performing detailed reconnaissance
actions.description: Kwampirs actors have successfully gained, then sustained persistent presence on victim networks for a time period ranging from three to 36 months, and deployed a targeted secondary module, which performed detailed reconnaissance.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Kwampirs RAT targets primary and secondary domain controllers, engineer servers, software development servers, and file servers
actions.description: The targeted network assets of the secondary module include primary domain controllers, secondary domain controllers, engineer servers used to develop and test ICS products and instruments, software development servers maintaining source code for software applications, and file servers used as shared repositories for research and development.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Kwampirs RAT infects companies in the imaging industry including networked scanner and copier-type devices
actions.description: Kwampirs campaign actors have targeted companies in the imaging industry, to include networked scanner and copier-type devices, with domain access to customer networks.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.

actions.name: Kwampirs RAT enables lateral CNE movement within victim networks via remote or cloud management access
actions.description: The FBI assesses these imaging vendors are targeted to gain access to customer networks, including remote or cloud management access, which could permit lateral CNE movement within victim networks.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.

actions.name: Kwampirs RAT downloads secondary modules separate from the RAT IOCs
actions.description: Secondary module(s) downloaded would be separate and different from the Kwampirs RAT IOCs, and may not have been remediated by anti-virus end point protection.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires an isolated, versioned Windows AD DC/member fixture; OS/AD versions and topology are missing. No version is assumed.
